flags: Length unresolved: NYSDOT gives 140 miles, FHWA 153. Omitted mileage and unsupported drive time. Cache describes the landscape and corridor but not detailed road grades, curves or the byway campaign.

Old Forge wagon trail is regional transport history, not an established original alignment of today’s byway. Dropped current “Around 1800” dating: cache gives a sequence between 1798 and abandonment by 1803 but no such hedge for construction. Used cached name John Francis Brown.

Dropped current implication that all eight Fulton Chain lakes were created by the Old Forge dam. The detailed cache says existing lakes were expanded in 1798 and describes portages between upper lakes. Route text names the chain without simplifying its hydrology.

Dropped Warrensburg’s unnamed local Cooper-writing claim and the unsupported-in-primary-evidence likelihood judgment about his visit. The cached secondary source hedges both; no named person or document is supplied for attribution under the prose rule.

Fort reconstruction chronology conflicts: Rome page gives 1973–1976; dedicated fort page distinguishes 1974 construction start, partial opening in 1976, and completion in 1978. Omitted dates; made reconstruction explicit. No live access or operating hours asserted.
